candidate.ownerConfirmation: The combat owner confirmed no source edits since the 10-action/58-test freeze; only tests and messages followed.

method.baselineLoading: git show 994a963:src/combat.js, imported as an independent JavaScript data URL
method.candidateLoading: ES module import of the working-tree src/combat.js
method.stopCondition: Stop on the baseline battle winner or the per-seed step limit; completion was not required.
method.partyActionSelection: Rotate that priority by simulation-step index, then choose its first action marked available by the baseline engine.
method.targetSelection: Self actions target p. Other actions try living enemies in actor order until the baseline accepts the order; submit the identical order to the candidate.
method.enemyActions: Each engine performs its own deterministic native enemy AI inside tickBattle.
comparisons: JSON equality of each submitted performAction result
JSON equality of summarizeBattle after every tick
JSON equality of the complete event array after every tick

limitations: Synthetic fixed combat inputs, not a complete campaign, UI, save/import or rendered scene test.
Only pre-expansion ME1 actions are exercised by this differential run; new power effects have separate tests.
Internal actor fields outside action results, event arrays and summarizeBattle are not compared directly.
Victory counts, enemy order counts and exact wall-clock start/end times were not recorded and are not inferred.
A deterministic regression comparison does not certify canonical numerical, visual or narrative fidelity.
